text:
Morgan: Quick intake for new-model bring-up — putting together the prompt + API integration patterns we'll ship to infra + devex. want feedback on structured output + function-calling examples for the onboarding checklist.

Anjali: SGTM. can you include a minimal eval prompt and an example of how we detect quality regressions vs. baseline?

Morgan: Yep — sketch below. focus: deterministic JSON output, explicit field types, and a fallback text blob. also adding an explicit test harness snippet for quant experiments (fp16 / int8 / q4).

Morgan: Prompt template (chat-style):
```
System: You are an assistant that outputs VALID JSON only. Never add extra commentary. If unsure, fill fields with null.
User: Given the product spec and user query, return: {"intent": string, "entities": [ {"type": string, "value": string} ], "response": string, "confidence": number }
```

Morgan: cURL + function-calling shim we recommend (pseudo):
```
curl https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "model": "open-variant-xl:1.0",
    "messages": [{"role":"system","content":"You are..."},{"role":"user","content":"..."}],
    "functions": [{"name":"structured_output","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"intent":{"type":"string"},"entities":{"type":"array"},"response":{"type":"string"},"confidence":{"type":"number"}},"required":["intent","response"]}}],
    "function_call": "structured_output"
  }'
```

Devin: For runtime, please add a small KV-cache note: when using prefix-cache across model variants (fp16 vs int8) ensure the cache key includes quantization tag, otherwise you'll get decoding artifacts.

Rachel: On devex: we should provide 2 templates — one "strict-json" for evals and ingestion, and one "human-readable" that allows short explanations for UI display. show both in onboarding doc.

Anjali: Regression detection idea: run canonical eval set (200 prompts) across baseline (prod model), new model fp16, new model int8. Capture metrics: exact-match JSON schema validity rate, intent F1, generation BLEU-ish or embedding similarity for responses, and avg confidence. If any metric drops > delta_threshold (e.g., 3%) flag for manual review.

Morgan: Adding quant experiment harness snippet (pseudo):
```
# run_evals.sh
for q in fp16 int8 q4_0; do
  export MODEL_TAG="newmodel-${q}"
  python eval_runner.py --model $MODEL_TAG --prompts eval_set.json --out results/${q}.json
done
# then produce a diff report comparing to baseline.json
```

Morgan: Example of structured output enforcement we expect in the chat response (single-line JSON):
```
{"intent":"upgrade_plan","entities":[{"type":"plan","value":"dedicated"}],"response":"We recommend Dedicated for predictable throughput.","confidence":0.92}
```

eval-bot: Integration test passed: schema-validator v2.1 — 198/200 valid JSON outputs on newmodel-fp16. see results link: https://internal/reports/1765126789

Anjali: Nice. what about hallucination checks? we should include a retrieval score and a provenance list (ids of docs used). add to structured schema: "sources": [ {"id": string, "score": number } ] optional.

Morgan: Good call. I'll extend schema to include sources and a "verbatim_evidence" field (optional) and rerun.

Devin: One more runtime note: when doing A/B rollouts, default routing should prefer a compatible quant level (e.g., routing rule: if request had cached key quant=q4_0 send to q4_0 cluster) — otherwise we break latency assumptions.

Rachel: For onboarding checklist items we should include: 1) eval set run (200 prompts), 2) quant matrix (fp16,int8,q4), 3) schema validity >= 98% for strict template, 4) regression delta thresholds, 5) KV-cache compatibility check, 6) devex docs + example curl/snippet.

Morgan: I'll drop final doc in /docs/onboarding/newmodel-templates and ping infra/devex when ready. thanks all :tada:
